# MuscleCheck

> MuscleCheck is a free iPhone and Android app that tracks your training with one tap per muscle group or activity, without logging sets or reps. "The workout app for people who hate logging."

- Platforms: iPhone and iPad (iOS 18+), Android 8+.
- Price: free. MuscleCheck Pro (iPhone only): automatic workout detection with Apple Health and progress photos — $1.99/month, $14.99/year or $29.99 lifetime.
- No account, name or email required; your history stays on your device.
- Any discipline: gym, yoga, pilates, calisthenics, cardio, stretching, or your own categories.
- Weekly checklist, streaks, history, statistics, home-screen widget and reminders (iPhone and Android). Siri shortcuts and Apple Health integration on iPhone.
- AI coach (iPhone with Apple Intelligence): suggests a training day — two muscle groups that go well together, with three example exercises each — based on what you've already trained. It only suggests; it never checks anything for you.
- Unlike set-by-set loggers such as Strong or Hevy, logging weights or exercises is optional.
- Languages: English, Spanish, French, Italian.
